pro_course_detail.title: Master the American Accent: Speak with Clarity & Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to speak English more clearly and naturally? As a linguist and pronunciation specialist, I help students correct pronunciation mistakes and gain confidence in their speech. My lessons are structured, supportive, and designed for real progress.  

What to Expect:  

- Focused Sound Training: You’ll read carefully chosen sentences. This allows me to identify pronunciation issues and help you correct all 50 American English sounds.  
 
- Custom Practice Materials: You’ll get word lists, spelling patterns, and tips to help you improve.  
 
- Practical Speaking Exercises: We’ll practice reading short articles aloud. This helps with pronunciation, fluency, and vocabulary growth.  
 
- Advanced Techniques: Learn how to stress words correctly, pronounce the schwa, relax your T, find your R, and handle -ed endings and final S sounds.  
 
- Step-by-Step Approach: Many students say they want a clear and systematic method—this course provides exactly that.  
 
- Optional Music-Based Practice: I’ve also created original songs with lyrics to help reinforce key sounds in a fun and natural way.  

I love teaching pronunciation and truly care about your progress. My lessons are structured but relaxed, detailed but enjoyable. You’ll feel supported every step of the way.  

Most students need about 10 class hours to practice and correct all 50 sounds. The best option is a 15-lesson package (45 minutes each). This allows time for refinement and conversation practice. Plus, ordering 15 lessons comes with a 10% discount.  

If you're ready to speak with more confidence, let’s get started!

pro_course_detail.title: Sound like a Native with the American English Mouth Posture!
pro_course_detail.description:
READ FIRST: I only accept serious students who will make time outside of class and put in the work required. I will guide you and give you the tools and techniques you need, but your results are mostly dependent on you. This isn't a traditional class where you show up, do a few exercises, and then forget about it until the next lesson.

OUTLINE

We're changing the SETTINGS of how you hold the vocal tract underneath the sounds, meaning that it's less about producing certain sounds (which will also be covered) and more about maintaining the correct settings at all times. That's the main thing that creates the accent, not the sounds.

This course has a few phases:

Phase 0: You'll become aware of your tongue and overall vocal tract, as well as your native posture. If needed, this will include special exercises designed to help you get better control over different parts of the tongue and throat. Phase 0 overlaps with phase 1.


Phase 1: We'll use the House Framework to build the core of the American posture, the foundation for everything else. This includes the schwa/UH/center of gravity. We'll also start working on breathing.


Phase 2: We'll use various techniques and exercises as we go through 2 sections to build the sounds with the posture and slowly start linking things together into syllables, words, and sentences. We'll also add linking, stress, etc as we go, but these are not a main focus in the beginning. 99% of people underestimate the work we're doing and want to jump right to words and sentences, but that's exactly the same as trying to run when you haven't learned to walk.

-SECTION 1 SOUNDS (mostly front):
T/D/N, S/Z, K/G/NG, AW (cot/caught), Y, EE, IH, EH, AH (cat), EI, AI

-SECTION 2 SOUNDS (mostly lips and back): F/V, P/B/M, SH/ZH, CH/J, TH/TH, W, U, O, UUH (book), OW, OI


Phase 3 (new centers of gravity): R (both + R-colored), L (both + L-colored). The R and dark L (mostly) take over the center of gravity and also "color"/blend with various sounds.

pro_course_detail.title: General Pronunciation Lessons (NOT Mouth Posture Course)
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is for anyone who wants to work on their American accent WITHOUT mouth posture. It is NOT possible to have a perfect accent without mouth posture. In addition, the mouth posture approach also makes things easier overall (though it might seem harder in the short term). However, if you just want to sound better/clearer (not perfect or near perfect) and/or you just want to improve certain areas of pronunciation such as stress or linking, then this class is for you. However, I do NOT teach advanced intonation. Basic intonation patterns are fine, but advanced intonation is a tricky topic that I dislike teaching. The exact content we focus on can be tailored to your needs, goals, and interests.

Note that the mouth posture class contains all areas of pronunciation, but things like stress, linking, and rhythm come little by little as we move through the course and are not the main focus, especially in the beginning. Please see the mouth posture course for more information. It is STRONGLY recommended that you at least learn the basic components of mouth posture because it helps everything else, especially the formation and clarity of individual sounds (and will also improve your listening indirectly). We can include these basics in this class if desired.

We can also do any ear training you might need, including hearing the difference between certain sounds, properly hearing the stress, and more.

1-hour classes at least twice a week is recommended, but not required.

Lastly, I do NOT teach beginners. You must have at least a B1/lower-intermediate level. B2/upper-intermediate is preferred. For B1 and B2 students (especially B1), these classes will also drastically improve your listening skills.

teacher_info.teaching_style:

I use many different materials, including but not limited to fiction, non-fiction, articles, podcasts, worksheets, art, and music. Of course, I also use games in teaching! I provide vocabulary lists for reading and listening exercises. I provide links to podcasts that align with your level and goals. 

I promise to listen to you and your interests. Coupled with my expertise in teaching, I am sure that you will improve your speaking, reading, writing, and listening skills!

course_info.trial_description: The trial lesson will be relaxed and enjoyable! We will get to know each other! You can tell me your goals and objectives for English language learning. Then, I will share my ideas for how I can help you reach your goals!

pro_course_detail.title: The Conversation-with-Materials Lesson (all ages)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to speak more confidently and use a more sophisticated vocabulary? This lesson focuses on speaking in work and/or play situations. Beginning, intermediate, and advanced English will speak about exciting topics. I provide MATERIALS  (such as vocabulary lists, video links, podcasts, etc.) for this customized lesson for you. We will use this material as a guide in your lesson. Materials come from GOOGLE and other English-language-related sites. I do not use a textbook for this class. Instead, I create individualized lessons to meet your goals.

Please read the lesson types carefully before booking. Expect a lesson plan for the option that you selected. I use my written record of every class session to chart progress.

pro_course_detail.title: The Conversation-without-Materials Lesson (or Package of Lessons) (all ages)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to practice speaking with a native English speaker?  

Do you want to improve your listening skills to understand a fast-paced conversation? 

Do you want to quickly transition between topics during a conversation? 

Do you have a difficult time entering a conversation? 

If you answer yes to any of these questions, this class is for you!

This lesson will help you to converse with new friends and colleagues!  We will work on listening and speaking skills! How?  We will engage in a real conversation!

As a New Yorker who works in international settings, the teacher individualizes small talk conversations to you and your needs! 

The teacher will not prepare materials for the class, and no writing will be checked after class.  

Please read the lesson types carefully before booking. Also, expect a lesson plan for the option that you selected.

pro_course_detail.title: The Conversation-with-Materials and Writing with AI Lesson (or package of lessons) (all ages)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to improve your confidence, fluency, and SPEAKING and WRITING level? If so, this lesson (or package of lessons) is for you!

You will improve your speaking fluency, pronunciation, and vocabulary on all topics to speak with your co-workers and  English-speaking friends! You will also improve your writing skills!

How? Each lesson will be structured with a particular goal in mind. You will use various structures for speaking. You will integrate higher-level vocabulary into your speech. You will practice the content of the lesson by writing short pieces after class. I correct written classwork outside of class time. I return the written work to the student before the lesson. Then, we (can) review that written work in class. 

I do not use a textbook for this lesson. Rather, I create individualized lessons to meet your goals. Materials come from GOOGLE and other English-language-related sites.

pro_course_detail.title: Short-Term! 1-2-3-4-5!
pro_course_detail.description: Do you have a specific project you need to kill? Do you need to present and impress someone? This class dedicates 100% of its time to the topics YOU need to accomplish your short-term goal. All work is done in class, together! You share the idea and tell me the audience for whom you will produce the final product. We will discuss the information you need to present to impress! Then, we will design at least one model to present that work! You WILL impress your boss, your colleague, or your client!

pro_course_detail.title: New York, New York!
pro_course_detail.description:
Will you travel to New York? Will you relocate to New York? Or ae you interested in learning about the city's past and present?  Do you want to save time and money? Guidebooks are great; apps are great. BUT -- they don't offer a personal New Yorker's perspective! 

This class offers a resident's view of the many things New York has to offer, tips for getting the most out of your visit or stay, and how to live within a budget in one of the most expensive cities in the world!  Topics, include but are not limited to the visual arts, the performing arts, sports, museums and galleries, transportation, climate, the five Boroughs (with a focus on the neighborhoods in Manhattan, but also cover Queens, Brooklyn, Staten Island, and the Bronx), food (from low to high cost!)

pro_course_detail.title: Level A Speakers (A1-A2)
pro_course_detail.description: This is for students who have not quite reached a conversational level. I will write every work I speak so we can begin with a "subtitled" approach as we work our way through a FAQ's document (Frequently Asked Questions) to help build confidence toward having a surface-level conversation and keep progressing toward more difficult topics.

pro_course_detail.title: General Spanish (A1-A2)
pro_course_detail.description: Although conversation is the best way to achieve fluency in a language, it is important to build a foundation first. We will lay that foundation with grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation all while working to introduce conversation into the session as soon as possible as that is the main goal!
